dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Hi, Nam! How's the weather in Bangkok today?
dialogue.reading: ˈhaɪ, ˈnɑːm! ˈhaʊz ðə ˈwɛðər ɪn ˈbæŋkɑːk təˈdeɪ?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: It's cloudy and windy. And it's raining a little.
dialogue.reading: ɪts ˈklaʊdi ənd ˈwɪndi. ənd ɪts ˈreɪnɪŋ ə ˈlɪtəl.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Oh no! Do you like rain?
dialogue.reading: ˈoʊ ˈnoʊ! duː juː ˈlaɪk ˈreɪn?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes, I do! I don't like the sun. It's too hot!
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs, aɪ ˈduː! aɪ ˈdoʊnt ˈlaɪk ðə ˈsʌn. ɪts ˈtuː ˈhɑːt!

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Here in Canada, it's sunny but very cold.
dialogue.reading: ˈhɪr ɪn ˈkænədə, ɪts ˈsʌni bʌt ˈvɛri ˈkoʊld.
